stemMd: A paragraph tells how a school orchestra adjusted to performing outdoors. Which sentence is least relevant and should be deleted?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The school cafeteria introduced a new soup that week.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Musicians clipped their sheet music to the stands.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Players moved into the shade to protect their instruments from heat.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The conductor shortened the rehearsal because of approaching rain.

explanationMd: The controlling topic is adaptation to outdoor conditions. Soup at the cafeteria does not contribute; clips, shade, and a shorter rehearsal all respond to those conditions.

distractorRationale.b: Clips are a practical adjustment to outdoor wind.
distractorRationale.c: Shade directly addresses an outdoor performance condition.
distractorRationale.d: Changing rehearsal length responds to outdoor weather.
